errors.text_span: Comic Characters (purple), Movie Characters (light blue), Teleplay Characters (teal), Novel Characters (dark blue), Game Characters (dark green), Custom Characters (yellow), Virtual Characters (light green), Scientists (pink), Athletes (red), Writers (orange), Musicians (light orange), and Actors/Influencers (gray)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns colors to categories. Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters are all shades of light blue, not purple, light blue, teal, dark blue, or dark green. Custom Characters are red, not yellow. Virtual Characters are blue, not light green. Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers are shades of light green, not pink, red, orange, light orange, or gray. The description also incorrectly splits Actors and Influencers into separate colors.

errors.text_span: The chart is divided into twelve segments, each representing a distinct category.
errors.evidence: The chart is divided into three main groups in the inner circle, with subgroups in the outer circle, not twelve distinct segments in a single layer.
Virtual Characters are colored blue, not light green.
Custom Characters are colored red, not yellow.
The description omits the hierarchical structure of the chart (inner and outer circles) and the subgroups under 'Virtual Characters' and 'Real Characters'.
The description omits the subgroup 'Artists' under 'Real Characters'.

errors.evidence: The segments are not ordered by size, and the description incorrectly states Comic Characters as the largest single segment (it is part of the larger 'Virtual Characters' group). The 'Actors/Influencers' segment is also not the smallest; it is part of the 'Real Characters' group.
